inference.resolution: area ~512x512, input aspect ratio kept, both sides rounded to a multiple of 16 (same rule as v2 training --gen_resize_mode area --gen_image_size 512); the conditioning image is resized (LANCZOS) to the same size
inference.sampler: DPMSolverMultistepScheduler (dpmsolver++, flow_shift 3.0) from each checkpoint's scheduler/ config (identical across the 4)
inference.prompt_template: the benchmark instruction verbatim, no system prompt override, no prefix/suffix (PhyEditBench TypeD uses the official packed-steps wrapper; PICABench uses superficial_prompt)

selection.rule: stratified random, one RNG stream per source: random.Random(f'20260927:<src>')
